name: Gabi
title: Collectables Trader
summary: A mainland collectables trader who buys rare finds and sealed Pokémon collection boxes, while supplying storage solutions for collectors.
sells: Card albums and collection storage supplies
notes: Gabi pays less than Cinder Market, but offers a convenient mainland option.
Cinder Market is the better choice when chasing maximum profit.
She does not buy individual trading cards.

name: Hassan
title: Drug Production Trader
summary: Cinder Market trader for finished drug products and drug production equipment.
buys: Finished drug bricks of all types
notes: Finished bricks are your best bet when selling.
Travel to Cinder Market requires appropriate transportation.

name: Kaito
title: Premium Collectables Trader
summary: Cinder Market's premium collectables buyer, offering stronger payouts for valuable finds.
notes: Cinder Market is generally the best payout for premium collectables.
Some collection systems have special turn-in rules.

name: Peter
title: Hunting Trader
summary: Hunting-focused trader for survivors making their living from the wild.
notes: Exact stock and accepted items may change with economy balancing.

name: Keiko
title: Fishing Trader
summary: Fishing specialist and one of the strongest routes for survival-focused income.
notes: Fishing is designed as a major money-making path in the server economy.
